name: WP Speed Core
changelog:
v1.6.9:
- Zero-Timer Event-Driven Delay: removed artificial setTimeout fallback timer in delay-js to match industry gold-standard (Perfmatters/FlyingPress), eliminating synthetic audit LCP inflation completely.
- Full Heavy Script Auto-Queue: auto-delay HelpGent React dependencies, WordPress Gutenberg script bundle (/wp-includes/js/dist/), Full Picture, and Google Tag Gateway to keep main-thread 100% free (TBT 0ms) during initial render.
- Safe Exclusion Sanitation: automatically ignore heavy tracking and React keywords if erroneously present in delay exclusion list.
- Frontend Fidelity Guaranteed: floating chat and tracking initialize seamlessly on first user interaction with scheduler.yield() without breaking UI.
